roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/billing-schedule/) with this contract beside it. You own the copy: replace the demo data, rearrange or drop sections, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: Billing schedule for one customer in a kit Card: the Card's header with the plan, one kit Table of upcoming and billed charges with the next charge marked in words and status as a word in a kit Badge, a failure Alert while a payment is still open, and a next-charge panel. Scheduled charges can open a kit Drawer to move the date, change the amount or skip the month.
must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (tables, dialogs, rows, rules, charts)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
At most one appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per view
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens
Status is a word in a kit Badge (Upcoming, Retrying, Invoiced, Paid, Failed, Waived), never colour alone
Upcoming and billed charges are one kit Table; do not build a local charges list
A failed payment that nothing has paid since is a kit Alert (danger) with the amount and date in its title, then when the retry runs and what to do before then
The next charge says Next charge in words after its description
Edit is a kit Drawer on scheduled charges only (no pencil on retries or billed rows); Skip asks once in a kit AlertDialog
Money arrives pre-formatted from your app; label example data as example

Render inside a main landmark (wrap the pattern, or your page content, in <main>); header and nav chrome, if any, use AppHeader / SideNav (or other header / nav landmarks) and nav stays reachable on small screens
defaults: Each state sits in a kit Card (size sm) and uses the Card's own header: title Billing schedule, the plan name as its description, and Ask (outline, MessageCircle) and Download all (ghost) as headerAction. Download all hides while the failure Alert shows

One Table (size lg) with Date (mono, first), Description, Status and Amount (end-aligned, mono, 500). Upcoming charges come first, oldest first, then billed charges, newest first. Below 480px the rows stack (Table stack)
Description has a muted second line (Prorated for 14 days, Credit applied); a failed charge's line is danger text (Card declined). A waived amount is subtle
The first scheduled row says Next charge after its description in info text, and its date and description read in the strong text colour
Status Badges are size sm with no icon: Upcoming primary, Retrying warning, Invoiced neutral, Paid success, Failed danger, Waived neutral
With an open failed payment, the failure Alert sits above the table with Update card, the one solid primary

Row actions show only when you pass their handler: the edit pencil with onSaveCharge, Download on billed rows with onDownloadInvoice. Both are icon Buttons (Table rowActionsAs="icons") named with the charge and date or the invoice

The edit Drawer is md on the right: Charge date (DatePicker), Amount (CurrencyInput), Apply to (RadioGroup, only for a split fee), Skip this month in footerStart, then Cancel and Save changes. After Save the row moves, focus returns to its pencil and a polite status says where it moved
nextOnly shows only the next-charge panel: Next charge on the date and the figure, a vertical Divider, Pays with and the payment method, then Change card (outline) on the right. It stacks below 40rem

summary is the overview card for a Billing page (the settings example uses it): no next-charge panel, the first `limit` charges (default 3) in two columns, charge with date and status, and amount, so it fits a half-width column, plus View all (ghost) via onViewAll

Loading is the Table loading state in the same four columns (header stays, Skeleton rows); empty is a kit Empty (CalendarDays, a curated icon) with one muted line; a load error is a danger Alert with Retry (outline, RotateCcw through action.icon)
doNot: Do not split upcoming and billed charges into two tables
Do not put an icon in the status Badges or mark status by colour alone
Do not reach into kit markup (Card, Table, Badge or Alert internals) from the pattern stylesheet
Do not show the next-charge panel beside the table; it is the nextOnly view
Do not add a second solid primary; Update card in the failure Alert is the one
Do not put a pencil on retries or billed rows
